rules: Supplement the social team: usually 1-2 combined event feed occasions/week; intentional Nov17/18/20 opening-week exception. No daily duplicate blasts.
Dates/times proposed, not approved or scheduled. Reconcile with the existing calendar.
Only ready_for_review entries have complete copy/art; concept_only entries must not be scheduled.
Approval of creative is separate from posting/scheduling/send authorization.
Passed proposed dates require a revised date; no automatic catch-up.
NYE before Nov18 2026 9am America/Chicago is pre-opening; no party times/prices.
Stories and Google/SMS extras are optional. selected_channels starts empty.
Verify IG bio CTA. Plain URL alternate is not claimed clickable.
Any current inventory claim needs fresh event/party-specific verification.

For each creative_choice_group select exactly one original or alternative concept when that occasion is used. A recommended concept is not a selected or approved concept. Alternatives do not add calendar occasions.
NYE is slower before opening, then varied booking invitations through Dec28. Jingle is weekly on proposed Fridays and ends Dec4. No automatic Dec6 campaign post.

planning_revision.basis: Jon requested slower NYE before opening, varied booking invitations through Dec 28, and weekly Jingle ending Dec 4.
planning_revision.launch_week_exception: Nov 17 reminder, Nov 18 opening and Nov 20 Jingle are three combined feed occasions. Keep Nov 17 concise and optional companions selective.
planning_revision.supersedes: Weekly NYE before opening; Jingle every 10-14 days; November 15 additional reminder; December 6 Jingle campaign post.

audience_direction.brand_weight: Use the newer maintained positioning as a light creative guide; campaign-specific audience direction takes priority.
audience_direction.jingle: Explicitly family-focused: families having fun together at Twisted Pin. More freedom from usual adult-first positioning. Santa offer remains a visit/photo, not bowling alongside guests.
audience_direction.nye_early: Earlier parties are very family friendly. Show and address families, parents and children planning an earlier celebration.
audience_direction.nye_later: Later parties lean more adult/friends/night-out, while families also attend. No adults-only claim or invented age restriction.
audience_direction.visual_direction: Vary subjects, scenes, composition and reasons to book within a consistent campaign identity. Do not repeat the same hero with a changing countdown number.

link_policy.primary: Use each canonical website page as the booking destination throughout.
link_policy.facebook_event: Optional secondary link after the actual Nov18 event is created and its URL verified. Follow-up booking posts do not depend on this URL.
link_policy.instagram: Verify the matching bio link; add native Story stickers where supported.
